title: Sequentially valid inference for probabilistic inflation forecasts
abstract: arXiv:2608.23064v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Traditional statistical tests are poorly suited for the sequential evaluation of probabilistic forecast calibration. We address this limitation in macroeconomic forecasting by applying a new sequential testing method based on e-values. The e-value-based methodology enables anytime-valid inference. It allows practitioners to test against calibration continuously without invalidating statistical guarantees. To illustrate the framework's practical value, we apply it to probabilistic inflation forecasts for the United States, the Euro Area, and Switzerland. Our analysis shows that the sequential approach gives detailed insights into the timing and nature of forecast misspecification. We find these diagnostics are particularly insightful during major structural breaks. During these events, we find evidence against calibration that static, full-sample tests often miss. translated_title: 概率通胀预测的序贯有效推断
translated_abstract: 传统的统计检验不适用于概率预测校准的序贯评估。我们在宏观经济预测中通过应用一种基于e值的新序贯检验方法来解决这一局限性。基于e值的方法能够实现任意时间有效的推断，允许实践者持续检验校准性，而不会破坏统计保证。为了说明该框架的实用价值，我们将其应用于美国、欧元区和瑞士的概率通胀预测。我们的分析表明，序贯方法能提供关于预测误设时机和性质的详细见解。我们发现，在重大结构性断裂期间，这些诊断尤其具有洞察力。在这些事件中，我们发现了反对校准的证据，而静态的全样本检验往往忽略这些证据。因此，这项工作表明，基于e值的检验是评估概率预测校准的一种实用方法。
tldr: 本文提出基于e值的序贯检验方法，用于概率通胀预测的实时校准评估，能捕捉传统静态检验忽略的结构性断裂期间的预测误设。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an e-value-based sequential testing method for real-time calibration assessment of probabilistic inflation forecasts, capturing forecast misspecification during structural breaks that traditional static tests miss.
